sourceMode: Mixed: OpenAI built-in image generation plus deterministic Pillow UI construction

runtimeProtocol.animations: Use PNG frames/sheets; GIF files are previews only.
runtimeProtocol.transparentCenters: Place ships, live text, or tinted fill rectangles underneath the overlay images.
runtimeProtocol.waveText: Prefer live text or BitmapFont. Use the included glyph atlas only when sprite lettering is required.
runtimeProtocol.projectiles: Advance once from frame 1 through frame 4, then hold frame 4 while the projectile remains alive.
